name: EZ Bar Pullover
steps: Lie on the bench with your feet planted and hold the EZ bar above your chest using a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Soften your elbows and brace your abdomen to keep your ribs down.
Reach the bar back over your head until your arms approach your ears or your ribs begin to lift.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same arc by driving through your lats while holding the elbow angle steady.
tips: Keep the slight bend in your elbows constant so the movement does not turn into a triceps extension.
Stop lowering before your shoulders pinch or your rib cage flares excessively upward.
